verses.sloka: तस्य क्रुद्धस्य वदनं दृष्ट्वा रामस्य धीमतः ।सर्वभूतानि वित्रेसुः प्राकम्पत च मेदिनी ।। ६.१०४.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya kruddhasya vadanaṁ dṛṣṭvā rāmasya dhīmataḥ ।sarvabhūtāni vitresuḥ prākampata ca medinī ।। 6.104.1 ।।

translations.english: Seeing enraged wise Rama's countenance, all beings on earth were shaken in fear.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार रावण हारा छोड़े हुए बाणों के आघात से मरे ओर घायल हो कर गिरे हुए बानरों से समरभूमि परिपूर्ण हो गईं

verses.sloka: सिंहशार्दूलवान् शैलः सञ्चचाल चलद्रुमः ।बभूव चातिक्षुभितः समुद्रः सरितां पतिः ।। ६.१०४.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: siṁhaśārdūlavān śailaḥ sañcacāla caladrumaḥ ।babhūva cātikṣubhitaḥ samudraḥ saritāṁ patiḥ ।। 6.104.2 ।।

translations.english: The mountains that were abode of lions and tigers with trees shook and the ocean, the king of rivers, was seen agitated.
translations.hindi: जैसे पतंगे जलती हुईं आग की लपट को नहीं सह सकते, बेसे ही रणभूमि में किसी भी मोर्चे के बानर रावण बी असह्य कणचर्षा के सामरे नहीं ठहर सकते थे

verses.sloka: खगाश्च खरनिर्घोषा गगने परुषा घनाः ।औत्पातिकानि नर्दन्तः समन्तात् परिचक्रमुः ।। ६.१०४.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: khagāśca kharanirghoṣā gagane paruṣā ghanāḥ ।autpātikāni nardantaḥ samantāt paricakramuḥ ।। 6.104.3 ।।

translations.english: Dreadful and portentous clouds went in circles all over sky looking like donkeys emitting harsh sounds.
translations.hindi: वानर गण पेने पेने बाणों से घायल हो कर चिल्लाते हुए भागने लमे । जैसे जलती हुईं आग में भूल से घुस जाने पर हाथी चिल्ला कर जागने लगते हैं

verses.sloka: रामं दृष्ट्वा सुसङ्क्रुद्धमुत्पातांश्च सुदारुणान् ।वित्रेसुः सर्वभूतानि रावणस्याभवद्भयेम् ।। ६.१०४.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāmaṁ dṛṣṭvā susaṅkruddhamutpātāṁśca sudāruṇān ।vitresuḥ sarvabhūtāni rāvaṇasyābhavadbhayem ।। 6.104.4 ।।

translations.english: Rama became highly furious, most dreadful sounds were rising up and all beings were frightened. Ravana was also afraid.
translations.hindi: उस युद्ध में रावण उन बानरों को बाशों से ऐसे बिध्वस्त कर सह्य था, जैसे मेघों को घटाओं की पवन (हड कर ) विध्वस्त कर डालता हे

verses.sloka: विमानस्थास्तदा देवा गन्धर्वाश्च महोरगाः ।ऋषिदानवदैत्याश्च गरुत्मन्तश्च खेचराः ।। ६.१०४.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: vimānasthāstadā devā gandharvāśca mahoragāḥ ।ṛṣidānavadaityāśca garutmantaśca khecarāḥ ।। 6.104.5 ।।

translations.english: Then from the aerial chariots, Devas, Gandharvas, great Nagas, sages, devils, giants, birds, and eagles watched the duel war that went on between the heroes clashing with different kinds of frightening weapons like at the dissolution of the world.
translations.hindi: राक्षसराज रावण बड़ो फुर्ती से बानरों की सेना को नष्ट करत। हुआ, तुरन्त समरभूमि में वहाँ पहुँचा, जहाँ श्रीराम चन्द्र जी थे

verses.sloka: ददृशुस्ते महायुद्धं लोकसंवर्तसंस्थितम् ।नानाप्रहरणैर्भीमैः शूरयोः सम्प्रयुद्ध्यतोः ।। ६.१०४.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: dadṛśuste mahāyuddhaṁ lokasaṁvartasaṁsthitam ।nānāpraharaṇairbhīmaiḥ śūrayoḥ samprayuddhyatoḥ ।। 6.104.6 ।।

translations.english: Then from the aerial chariots, Devas, Gandharvas, great Nagas, sages, devils, giants, birds, and eagles watched the duel war that went on between the heroes clashing with different kinds of frightening weapons like at the dissolution of the world.
translations.hindi: उधर जब सुग्रीव ने देखा कि, वानर लोग, व्यूह भङ्ग कर रणभूमि से भाग रहे हैं, तब वे सुषेण को ( बानरों की रक्षा के लिए ) सेन्यशिविर में नियत कर, स्वयं लड़ने को तैयार हुए

verses.sloka: ऊचुः सुरासुराः सर्वे तदा विग्रहमागताः ।प्रेक्षमाणा महद्युद्धं वाक्यं भक्त्या प्रहृष्टवत् ।। ६.१०४.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ūcuḥ surāsurāḥ sarve tadā vigrahamāgatāḥ ।prekṣamāṇā mahadyuddhaṁ vākyaṁ bhaktyā prahṛṣṭavat ।। 6.104.7 ।।

translations.english: Then watching the great war, all the Suras, Asuras, lost control and overcome with happiness spoke these words with devotion.

verses.sloka: दशग्रीवं जयेत्याहुरसुराः समवस्थिताः ।देवा राममथोचुस्ते त्वं जयेति पुनःपुनः ।। ६.१०४.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: daśagrīvaṁ jayetyāhurasurāḥ samavasthitāḥ ।devā rāmamathocuste tvaṁ jayeti punaḥpunaḥ ।। 6.104.8 ।।

translations.english: Firmly established the Asuras uttered 'Victory to the Ten headed Ravana', and Devas for their part pronounced 'Rama be victorious' again and again.

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रोधाद्राघवस्य स रावणः ।प्रहर्तुकामो दुष्टात्मा स्पृशन् प्रहरणं महत् ।। ६.१०४.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare krodhādrāghavasya sa rāvaṇaḥ ।prahartukāmo duṣṭātmā spṛśan praharaṇaṁ mahat ।। 6.104.9 ।।

translations.english: In the meantime, the evil self Ravana who is called so, as he makes others cry, in intense anger making loud noise, stroking an unassailable weapon which was like the thunderbolt, capable of killing all enemies, a spike which closely resembled mountain peaks, dreadful even to think, like a mass of smoke, sharp and pointed, blazing like at the dissolution of the universe, very frightening, difficult to hand le, like the god of death, a terror for all beings, frightening, tearing, splitting, glowing like trident seized hold of to attack Rama.

verses.sloka: वज्रसारं महानादं सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणम् ।शैलशृङ्गनिभैः कूटैश्चितं दृष्टिभयावहम् ।। ६.१०४.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: vajrasāraṁ mahānādaṁ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇam ।śailaśṛṅganibhaiḥ kūṭaiścitaṁ dṛṣṭibhayāvaham ।। 6.104.10 ।।

translations.english: In the meantime, the evil self Ravana who is called so, as he makes others cry, in intense anger making loud noise, stroking an unassailable weapon which was like the thunderbolt, capable of killing all enemies, a spike which closely resembled mountain peaks, dreadful even to think, like a mass of smoke, sharp and pointed, blazing like at the dissolution of the universe, very frightening, difficult to hand le, like the god of death, a terror for all beings, frightening, tearing, splitting, glowing like trident seized hold of to attack Rama.
translations.hindi: वानरराज सुग्रीव ने विशाल शरीरधारी राक्षसों को वैसे ही मदेन किया, जैसे प्रलयकालीन पवन, बड़े बड़े पर्वेतों को चूर चूर कर डालता है

verses.sloka: सधूममिव तीक्ष्णाग्रं युगान्ताग्निचयोपमम् ।अतिरौद्रमनासाद्यं कालेनापि दुरासदम् ।। ६.१०४.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: sadhūmamiva tīkṣṇāgraṁ yugāntāgnicayopamam ।atiraudramanāsādyaṁ kālenāpi durāsadam ।। 6.104.11 ।।

translations.english: In the meantime, the evil self Ravana who is called so, as he makes others cry, in intense anger making loud noise, stroking an unassailable weapon which was like the thunderbolt, capable of killing all enemies, a spike which closely resembled mountain peaks, dreadful even to think, like a mass of smoke, sharp and pointed, blazing like at the dissolution of the universe, very frightening, difficult to hand le, like the god of death, a terror for all beings, frightening, tearing, splitting, glowing like trident seized hold of to attack Rama.

verses.sloka: त्रासनं सर्वभूतानां दारणं भेदनं तदा ।प्रदीप्तमिव रोषेण शूलं जग्राह रावणः ।। ६.१०४.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: trāsanaṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ dāraṇaṁ bhedanaṁ tadā ।pradīptamiva roṣeṇa śūlaṁ jagrāha rāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.104.12 ।।

translations.english: In the meantime, the evil self Ravana who is called so, as he makes others cry, in intense anger making loud noise, stroking an unassailable weapon which was like the thunderbolt, capable of killing all enemies, a spike which closely resembled mountain peaks, dreadful even to think, like a mass of smoke, sharp and pointed, blazing like at the dissolution of the universe, very frightening, difficult to hand le, like the god of death, a terror for all beings, frightening, tearing, splitting, glowing like trident seized hold of to attack Rama.
translations.hindi: उस समय कपिराज सुग्रीव के फेंके हुए वृक्षो और पत्थरों से शत्रु राक्षसों के सिर चकनाचूर दो जांते थे और वे वैसे ही भूमि पर गार पड़ते थे, जैसे टूठे हुए पवत

verses.sloka: तच्छूलं परमक्रुद्धो मध्ये जग्राह वीर्यवान् ।अनेकैः समरे शूरै राक्षसैः परिवारितः ।। ६.१०४.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tacchūlaṁ paramakruddho madhye jagrāha vīryavān ।anekaiḥ samare śūrai rākṣasaiḥ parivāritaḥ ।। 6.104.13 ।।

translations.english: In the battlefield surrounded by Rakshasa heroes, enraged valiant Ravana took up the trident holding it in the middle.

verses.sloka: समुद्यम्य महाकायो ननाद युधि भैरवम् ।संरक्तनयनो रोषात् स्वसैन्यमभिहर्षयन् ।। ६.१०४.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: samudyamya mahākāyo nanāda yudhi bhairavam ।saṁraktanayano roṣāt svasainyamabhiharṣayan ।। 6.104.14 ।।

translations.english: Gigantic Ravana, eyes turned red in anger, raising the trident made formidable noise to make his army extremely joyful in the battlefield.

verses.sloka: पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षं च दिशश्च प्रदिशस्तथा ।प्राकम्पयत्तदा शब्दो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य दारुणः ।। ६.१०४.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: pṛthivīṁ cāntarikṣaṁ ca diśaśca pradiśastathā ।prākampayattadā śabdo rākṣasendrasya dāruṇaḥ ।। 6.104.15 ।।

translations.english: By the horrible sound made by the Rakshasa king, the earth, even the heavens, similarly the quarters and corners trembled.

verses.sloka: अतिनादस्य नादेन तेन तस्य दुरात्मनः ।सर्वभूतानि वित्रेसुः सागरश्च प्रचुक्षुभे ।। ६.१०४.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: atinādasya nādena tena tasya durātmanaḥ ।sarvabhūtāni vitresuḥ sāgaraśca pracukṣubhe ।। 6.104.16 ।।

translations.english: By the loud roar of the evilminded Ravana's sound, all living beings feared and even the ocean was set to tremble.
translations.hindi: उसने वानरी सेना के सामने जा, सुग्रीव के ऊपर बाणवृष्टि कर और घबराये हुए रात्तसों को हर्षित कर, उन्हें पुन: युद्ध में भ्रवृत्त किआ

verses.sloka: स गृहीत्वा महावीर्यः शूलं तद्रावणो महत् ।विनद्य सुमहानादं रामं परुषमब्रवीत् ।। ६.१०४.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa gṛhītvā mahāvīryaḥ śūlaṁ tadrāvaṇo mahat ।vinadya sumahānādaṁ rāmaṁ paruṣamabravīt ।। 6.104.17 ।।

translations.english: Ravana who was endowed with extraordinary valour, taking hold of the trident, addressed Rama harshly in a loud tone.
translations.hindi: विरूपाज्ष द्वारा पेने बाणों से घायल. हो, महाक्रोधी सुग्रीव क्रद्ध हुए और उन्होंने उस राक्षस को मार डालने की अपने मन : में ठानी

verses.sloka: शूलो ऽयं वज्रसारस्ते राम रोषान्मयोद्यतः ।तव भ्रातृसहायस्य सद्यः प्राणान् हरिष्यति ।। ६.१०४.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: śūlo 'yaṁ vajrasāraste rāma roṣānmayodyataḥ ।tava bhrātṛsahāyasya sadyaḥ prāṇān hariṣyati ।। 6.104.18 ।।

translations.english: "O Rama! This thunderbolt like trident taken up by me now will take away your life along with your brother's."

verses.sloka: रक्षसामद्य शूराणां निहतानां चमूमुखे ।त्वां निहत्य रणश्लाघिन् करोमि तरसा समम् ।तिष्ठेदानीं निहन्मि त्वामेष शूलेन राघव ।। ६.१०४.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: rakṣasāmadya śūrāṇāṁ nihatānāṁ camūmukhe ।tvāṁ nihatya raṇaślāghin karomi tarasā samam ।tiṣṭhedānīṁ nihanmi tvāmeṣa śūlena rāghava ।। 6.104.19 ।।

translations.english: "I, who commend warfare, will quickly kill you today in the forefront of the army and join you with Rakshasa heroes who were killed."
translations.hindi: सुग्रीव के वृक्षप्रहार की चोट से वह गजराज एक धनुष ( अथात्‌ चार हाथ ) पीछे हट गया और चिग्चाइता हुआ बैठ गया

verses.sloka: एवमुक्त्वा स चिक्षेप तच्छूलं राक्षसाधिपः ।। ६.१०४.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā sa cikṣepa tacchūlaṁ rākṣasādhipaḥ ।। 6.104.20 ।।

translations.english: "O Raghava! Stay there. Right now, I will kill you with this trident." Having spoken that way, Ravana hurled the trident.
translations.hindi: बब गज को बेकाम हुआ जान, बलवान विरूपाक्ष उस हाथी से तुरन्त न'चे कूद पडा ओर अपने शत्रु वानरराज सुम्रोब के सामने हुआ

verses.sloka: तद्रावणकरान्मुक्तं विद्युज्ज्वालासमाकुलम् ।अष्टघण्टं महानादं वियद्गतमशोभत ।। ६.१०४.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadrāvaṇakarānmuktaṁ vidyujjvālāsamākulam ।aṣṭaghaṇṭaṁ mahānādaṁ viyadgatamaśobhata ।। 6.104.21 ।।

translations.english: The trident discharged from Ravana's hand, made circles of lightning, and covered the atmosphere with its glow and shine along with eight bells making loud sounds.
translations.hindi: बेल के चमड़े की ढाल और तलवार ले कर, विरूपाक्ष सामने खड़े हुए सुप्रीव को बलकारता हुआ उनके ऊपर लपका

verses.sloka: तच्छूलं राघवो दृष्ट्वा ज्वलन्तं घोरदर्शनम् ।ससर्ज विशिखान् रामश्चापमायम्य वीर्यवान् ।। ६.१०४.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tacchūlaṁ rāghavo dṛṣṭvā jvalantaṁ ghoradarśanam ।sasarja viśikhān rāmaścāpamāyamya vīryavān ।। 6.104.22 ।।

translations.english: Valiant Raghava, seeing the glowing trident that was horrible to look at, loosed a number of arrows at it.

verses.sloka: आपतन्तं शरौघेण वारयामास राघवः ।उत्पतन्तं युगान्ताग्निं जलौघैरिव वासवः ।। ६.१०४.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: āpatantaṁ śaraugheṇa vārayāmāsa rāghavaḥ ।utpatantaṁ yugāntāgniṁ jalaughairiva vāsavaḥ ।। 6.104.23 ।।

translations.english: Raghava intercepted the trident, just as the fire was obstructed by the flow of water, at the time of universal dissolution, and obstructed.

verses.sloka: निर्ददाह स तान् बाणान् रामकार्मुकनिस्सृतान् ।रावणस्य महाशूलः पतङ्गानिव पावकः ।। ६.१०४.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: nirdadāha sa tān bāṇān rāmakārmukanissṛtān ।rāvaṇasya mahāśūlaḥ pataṅgāniva pāvakaḥ ।। 6.104.24 ।।

translations.english: The arrows released from Rama's bow fell on the great trident of Ravana and burnt like moths falling in fire.
translations.hindi: उस बलवान राक्षस विरूपाक्ष केखङ्ग की चोट खा कर, सुग्रीव खुहूत्त भर के लिए कुळ कुछ मूर्छित से हो गए

verses.sloka: तान् दृष्ट्वा भस्मसाद्भूतान् शूल संस्पर्शचूर्णितान् ।सायकानन्तरिक्षस्थान् राघवः क्रोधमाहरत् ।। ६.१०४.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā bhasmasādbhūtān śūla saṁsparśacūrṇitān ।sāyakānantarikṣasthān rāghavaḥ krodhamāharat ।। 6.104.25 ।।

translations.english: Rama was overcome with fury on seeing his arrows being crushed to powder in the sky on touching the trident and reduced to ashes.
translations.hindi: जब वे सावधान हुए, तब उन्होने इस महायुद्ध में सहसा उछल और मुट्ठी बाँच, एक घूँसा बड़े जोर से विरूपाक्ष की छाती में मारा

verses.sloka: स तां मातलिना ऽ ऽनीतां शक्तिं वासवनिर्मिताम् ।जग्राह परमक्रुद्धो राघवो रघुनन्दनः ।। ६.१०४.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tāṁ mātalinā ' 'nītāṁ śaktiṁ vāsavanirmitām ।jagrāha paramakruddho rāghavo raghunandanaḥ ।। 6.104.26 ।।

translations.english: Raghava, the enhancer of the joy of Raghus, lifted up the javelin brought by Matali, esteemed by Indra.
translations.hindi: ब किन्तु बहू शत्रु पर वार करने और शत्रु का बार बचाने में बड़ा निपुण था । अतः बहू उस प्रहार को बच! गया और फिर उसने सुम्नीव के एक घूँसा मारा । अपने प्रहार को व्यर्थ जाते देख ( ओर उसके प्रहार से पीड़ित होने के कारण ) वानरराज मुग्रीब ओर भी अधिक क्रुद्ध हुए और विरूपाक्ष पर प्रहार करने की घात में रहे

verses.sloka: सा तोलिता बलवता शक्तिर्घण्टाकृतस्वना ।नभः प्रज्वालयामास युगान्तोल्केव सप्रभा ।। ६.१०४.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sā tolitā balavatā śaktirghaṇṭākṛtasvanā ।nabhaḥ prajvālayāmāsa yugāntolkeva saprabhā ।। 6.104.27 ।।

translations.english: When mighty Rama lifted up that javelin, it rendered sonorous sounds of bells and lit up the sky like a meteor at the end of the universal dissolution.
translations.hindi: पद्भयामभिइतोपतत्‌-_श्राकुञ्चितजानुरभवादित्यथः; | ( रा० ) १०६२ युद्धकाण्डे _ उनका कवच काट कर गिरा दिया । उस खड्गप्रहार से सुग्रीब ने जमीन पर घुटने टेक दिए । घुटने ठेके हुए सुग्रीव ने सहसा उठ कर ओर भयङ्कर नाद करते हुए; वज के समान एक चपेटा डसके मारना चाहा;

verses.sloka: सा क्षिप्ता राक्षसेन्द्रस्य तस्मिन् शूले पपात ह ।भिन्नः शक्त्या महान् शूलो निपपात हतद्युतिः ।। ६.१०४.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sā kṣiptā rākṣasendrasya tasmin śūle papāta ha ।bhinnaḥ śaktyā mahān śūlo nipapāta hatadyutiḥ ।। 6.104.28 ।।

translations.english: With the hurling of the javelin by Rama at the great trident of Ravana and on (the javelin) touching the trident, it was broken, lost its splendour and fell down.

verses.sloka: निर्बिभेद ततो बाणैर्हयानस्य महाजवान् ।रामस्तीक्ष्णैर्महावेगैर्वज्रकल्पैः शितैः शरैः ।। ६.१०४.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: nirbibheda tato bāṇairhayānasya mahājavān ।rāmastīkṣṇairmahāvegairvajrakalpaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.104.29 ।।

translations.english: Rama then released arrows endowed with great speed, shower of multitude of arrows straight into the horses of Ravana and shattered them.

verses.sloka: निर्बिभेदोरसि ततो रावणं निशितैः शरैः ।राघवः परमायत्तो ललाटे पत्रिभिस्त्रिभिः ।। ६.१०४.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: nirbibhedorasi tato rāvaṇaṁ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।rāghavaḥ paramāyatto lalāṭe patribhistribhiḥ ।। 6.104.30 ।।

translations.english: Raghava pierced into the chest of Ravana sharp arrows and with great effort three sharp arrows on the forehead.

verses.sloka: स शरैर्भिन्नसर्वाङ्गो गात्रप्रस्रुतशोणितः ।राक्षसेन्द्रः समूहस्थः फुल्लाशोक इवाबभौ ।। ६.१०४.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa śarairbhinnasarvāṅgo gātraprasrutaśoṇitaḥ ।rākṣasendraḥ samūhasthaḥ phullāśoka ivābabhau ।। 6.104.31 ।।

translations.english: Pierced all over the limbs with arrows, blood flowing from the limbs, he (Rakshasa king) appeared like an Ashoka tree in the gathering.

verses.sloka: स रामबाणैरभिविद्धगात्रो निशाचरेन्द्रः क्षतजार्द्रगात्रः ।जगाम खेदं च समाजमध्ये क्रोधं च चक्रे सुभृशं तदानीम् ।। ६.१०४.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa rāmabāṇairabhividdhagātro niśācarendraḥ kṣatajārdragātraḥ ।jagāma khedaṁ ca samājamadhye krodhaṁ ca cakre subhṛśaṁ tadānīm ।। 6.104.32 ।।

translations.english: His limbs pierced deep by Rama's arrows, his body wet with blood, that lord of the night-rangers, in the midst of his host, was then filled with weariness and with exceeding wrath.

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे चतुरुत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। १०४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe caturuttaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 104 ।।

translations.hindi: वानरों ने क्रोध में भर आंखे घुमाते हुए और भागों सहि रुधिर से सने विरूपाक्ष को, जो उस समय सचमुच अपने विरूपाक्ष” नाम को चरितार्थ कर रहा था, देखा
